features.quote: Explicit call budget. Needed for the INFEASIBLE_RESOURCE class and to cap cost/loops generally.
If the model hits the iteration/budget cap without a FINAL, we force one turn
features.justification_quote: so every episode ends in a judgeable answer

features.quote: We never inject success/failure language into that prompt — only "give your FINAL answer"
features.justification_quote: to avoid steering the model toward claiming or disclaiming success
